subject: Expired pilot credits — grace window request and reconciliation
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearsky.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearsky.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expired pilot credits — request for grace window

Hi Alex,

Quick one — our 60-day pilot with Redwood wrapped last week and the sandbox credits expired mid-July. We were in the middle of some scale tests (vectorized feature extraction + re-ranking) and lost access to the account resources.

Is there any chance Redwood can provision a short grace window or one-off credit top-up so we can finish the last evaluation runs? We have a purchase order in flight but procurement needs a few business days to finalize.

Why this matters: the remaining tests validate a latency/cost tradeoff that will be critical for our CFO sign-off. If we can complete two more workload runs (~10k tokens total) we can close internally next week.

Happy to provide a short plan and the PO reference. Thanks for considering — appreciate it.

— Liam O'Connor
Head of ML Engineering | ClearSky Analytics
liam.oconnor@clearsky.ai
+1 415-555-0192

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearsky.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearsky.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expired pilot credits — request for grace window

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the note and context. I’m happy to help get you back up for the final validation runs. We can offer a one-time 14-day grace credit top-up for the pilot while the PO clears. A couple of quick asks so we can process this:

- Confirm the PO number or expected date procurement will complete (even a tentative date is fine).
- Confirm approximate token usage you expect over the 14-day window (you mentioned ~10k, can you confirm).
- Will you need higher concurrency for those runs? If so let us know target qps so we can reserve capacity.

I’ve looped in Marissa (ops & credits) to approve the addendum and attach the credit file when ready. This is a one-time exception and we’ll record it against deal CK-4571.

If that works we’ll generate a credit addendum and a short invoice for accounting.

Best,
Alex
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearsky.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearsky.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expired pilot credits — request for grace window

Alex / Marissa,

Thanks — that would be great. PO is currently routing; expected sign-off Thursday 07/22. PO ref (tentative): PO-2027-8814. Confirming the usage estimate — we anticipate ~10k tokens across 3 runs (two larger vectorization jobs and a final re-ranking pass). No special concurrency needs beyond baseline.

We agree to the one-time exception. Please send the addendum and invoice and we’ll route for expedited approval. Also loop legal if there are any changes to terms.

Appreciate the quick help,
— Liam

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@clearsky.ai>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@clearsky.ai>, Legal <legal@clearsky.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Credit addendum + limited grace window (CK-4571)

Hi Liam —

Following Alex’s note, we’ve approved a one-time credit addendum for ClearSky Analytics (deal CK-4571). Summary of terms: 

- Provision: 14 calendar day access starting when credits are applied.
- Amount: equivalent to 10,000 tokens (productive-run allocation).
- Purpose: finish the remaining pilot validation runs as described by Liam.
- Limitation: one-time exception; future top-ups require PO/invoice before provisioning.

Attachments: credit_addendum_CK-4571.pdf (signed internal approval stub), invoice_1529_CK-4571.pdf (billing for record). Please review and confirm acceptance so we can apply the credits today.

Notes for Procurement/Legal: this addendum does not change core SOW or pricing; it is a limited operational credit tied to the PO reference. If you need an updated MSA/contract version we can escalate but this addendum is our preferred quick path.

Liam — once you confirm I’ll route the credits to your sandbox and send a confirmation when they’re live.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: credit_addendum_CK-4571.pdf (application/pdf), invoice_1529_CK-4571.pdf (application/pdf)
